frames.note: Angular crown masses, simplified flat surfaces and strongly saturated autumn crowns remain far from organic layered calibration look; no defensible integer uplift. High view: canopy tiny, weak diagnostic power; broad uniform cyan water with bright glint. A lacks outer ground/road grid present in D/F; coverage confound, no causal shader attribution.
